items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 09 June 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving complex low to the northwest of Britain.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, soon increasing 5 or 6, veering west 4 or 5 later in the afternoon, decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate this evening, then slight overnight.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in places, backing south or southwest 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, building moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, rain spreading from the west overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation.
